blocks.text: Kishilik olmoshlari: ega va to'ldiruvchi shakli

O'zbek tilida «men» olmoshi kelishik qo'shimchalari bilan o'zgaradi: men**i**, men**ga**, men**dan**, men **bilan**. Ingliz tilida kelishik yo'q, lekin kishilik olmoshlarining **ikki shakli** bor. **Ega shakli** (I, he, she, we, they) harakatni kim bajarayotganini bildiradi. **To'ldiruvchi shakli** (me, him, her, us, them) harakat kimga qaratilganini bildiradi. Bitta **me** o'zbekchadagi bir nechta kelishikning o'rnini bosadi: «meni», «menga», «mendan», «men bilan». Qaysi biri ekanini fe'l yoki predlog ko'rsatadi.

Qaysi shaklni tanlash olmoshning gapdagi o'rniga bog'liq. Fe'ldan **oldin**, ega o'rnida — **I, he, she, we, they**. Fe'ldan yoki predlogdan **keyin** — **me, him, her, us, them**. **you** va **it** ikkala o'rinda ham bir xil. Shuning uchun bitta gapda ikkala shakl yonma-yon kelishi mumkin: **She** loves **him**, but **he** doesn't love **her**.
Fe'ldan keyin: help me, call him, tell them

Fe'ldan keyin kelgan olmosh doim to'ldiruvchi shaklida bo'ladi — o'zbekchada u tushum («meni») yoki jo'nalish («menga») kelishigida tursa ham. E'tibor bering: ba'zi fe'llar o'zbekchada `-ga` yoki `-dan` bilan kelsa ham, inglizchada **predlogsiz** ishlatiladi: **help me** — menga yordam ber, **ask him** — undan so'ra, **call us** — bizga qo'ng'iroq qil, **tell them** — ularga ayt. Aksincha, ba'zi fe'llar predlog talab qiladi: **listen to** me — meni tingla, **wait for** him — uni kut, **look at** them — ularga qara. Bularni ibora sifatida yodlang.

items.text: Could you **help me** with this suitcase?
If you see Bekzod, **ask him** about the tickets.
Please **listen to me** for a minute.

blocks.text: Predlogdan keyin: with me, for her, about them

Predlogdan keyin ham faqat to'ldiruvchi shakli ishlatiladi. O'zbekchada ko'makchi olmoshdan **keyin** keladi («men bilan», «u uchun», «ular haqida»), inglizchada esa predlog olmoshdan **oldin** turadi: **with me**, **for her**, **about them**. «with I», «for she» deyilmaydi — bu eng ko'p uchraydigan xatolardan biri.

items.text: Do you want to come **with us**?

blocks.text: he / him yoki she / her: o'zbekcha «u» ga e'tibor

O'zbekchada «u», «uni», «unga» erkakka ham, ayolga ham, narsaga ham aytiladi. Ingliz tilida esa uch xil: erkak — **he / him**, ayol — **she / her**, narsa va hayvon — **it / it**. Shuning uchun «Uni kecha ko'rdim» gapini tarjima qilishdan oldin «u» kim ekanini o'ylang: I saw **him** (Aziz), I saw **her** (Madina), I saw **it** (film). Ko'plikda farq yo'q: odamlar ham, narsalar ham — **they / them**. E'tibor bering: o'zbekchada birlikda turgan ba'zi narsalar inglizchada ko'plikda bo'ladi (glasses — ko'zoynak, jeans — jinsi shim), shuning uchun ular haqida **them** deyiladi.

items.text: Aziz is my neighbour. I see **him** every morning.
items.translation: Aziz — qo'shnim. **Uni** har kuni ertalab ko'raman.

items.text: Madina phoned, so I called **her** back.
items.translation: Madina qo'ng'iroq qilgan ekan, **unga** qaytib qo'ng'iroq qildim.

items.text: This film is great. Have you seen **it**?
Where are my glasses? I can't find **them**.

blocks.text: O'zbekchada to'ldiruvchi ko'pincha tushirib qoldiriladi: «Kitobni o'qidingmi? — Ha, o'qidim.» Ingliz tilida fe'l to'ldiruvchi talab qilsa, olmosh **albatta** aytiladi: Yes, I read **it**. Ayniqsa **it** va **them** ning tushib qolishi o'zbeklarda juda ko'p uchraydi: «I like.» emas — **I like it.**; «I bought.» emas — **I bought them.**

items.text: Where are the keys? — I put **them** on the shelf.
Did you buy the tickets? — Yes, I bought **them** online.
items.translation: Chiptalarni oldingizmi? — Ha, **ularni** internet orqali oldim.

blocks.text: Yolg'iz olmosh: It's me, Me too

So'zlashuvda gapdan alohida, yolg'iz turgan olmosh ham odatda to'ldiruvchi shaklida bo'ladi: Who's there? — **It's me.** (Kim u? — Menman.); I'm hungry. — **Me too.** (Men ham.); Who wants more tea? — **Me!** (Men!). «It is I» — eskirgan, juda rasmiy shakl, kundalik tilda ishlatilmaydi. **than** va **as** dan keyin ham shunday: She's older **than me** (→ 88-dars).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I love she.» → **I love her.**; «Come with I.» → **Come with me.**; «Him is my brother.» → **He is my brother.** (fe'ldan oldin — ega shakli); «Ask from him.» → **Ask him.**; «Listen me.» → **Listen to me.**; «Do you like it? — Yes, I like.» → **Yes, I like it.** Yana bir xato — erkak haqida **her**, ayol haqida **him** deyish: o'zbekcha «uni» ni tarjima qilganda jinsga qarang.
Eslab qolish: fe'ldan **oldin** — I, he, she, we, they; fe'ldan yoki predlogdan **keyin** — me, him, her, us, them. **you** va **it** hech qachon o'zgarmaydi.

Keyingi darslar shu jadvalni davom ettiradi: egalik olmoshlari my / his / her — 60-dars; mine / yours — 61-dars; to'rt shakl birga (I / me / my / mine) — 62-dars; myself / themselves — 63-dars. Give **me** the book va give it **to me** farqi — 96-dars.

examples.title: Verb + **me**, **you**, **us**
examples.description: Fe'ldan keyin **me**, **you**, **us**. O'zbekchada «meni», «menga», «bizni», «bizga» — inglizchada bitta shakl va ko'pincha predlogsiz: help **me**, call **us**.

sentences.text: Can you **help me** with my homework, please?
sentences.translation: Uy vazifamga **yordam bera olasizmi**, iltimos?

sentences.text: My mum **calls me** every evening from Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Onam har kuni kechqurun Buxorodan **menga qo'ng'iroq qiladi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, I'll **meet you** at the station.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, **sizni** vokzalda **kutib olaman**.

sentences.text: Our teacher **gives us** a lot of homework.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz **bizga** ko'p uy vazifasi **beradi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **invited us** to her birthday party on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Sara **bizni** shanba kuni tug'ilgan kuniga **taklif qildi**.

sentences.text: Please **tell me** the truth about the money.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, pul haqida **menga** rostini **ayting**.

sentences.text: Excuse me, could you **show us** the way to the museum?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, **bizga** muzeyga boradigan yo'lni **ko'rsatib yubora olasizmi**?

sentences.text: I don't **understand you** — can you speak more slowly?
sentences.translation: **Sizni tushunmayapman** — sekinroq gapira olasizmi?

sentences.text: Mum, I **miss you** so much!
sentences.translation: Onajon, **sizni** juda **sog'indim**!

sentences.text: When we were children, our grandmother **taught us** to cook plov.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimizda buvimiz **bizga** palov pishirishni **o'rgatgan**.

examples.title: **him** and **her**: a man or a woman?
examples.description: Erkak haqida — **him**, ayol haqida — **her**. O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham «uni», «unga», shuning uchun avval «u» kim ekanini o'ylang.

sentences.text: Bekzod is my best friend. I **trust him** completely.
sentences.translation: Bekzod — eng yaqin do'stim. **Unga** to'liq **ishonaman**.

sentences.text: Where's Madina? I need to **talk to her**.
sentences.translation: Madina qayerda? **U bilan gaplashishim** kerak.

sentences.text: Tom is new in our office, and I don't **know him** well.
sentences.translation: Tom ofisimizda yangi, men **uni** yaxshi **tanimayman**.

sentences.text: My grandmother lives alone, so we **visit her** every Sunday.
sentences.translation: Buvim yolg'iz yashaydi, shuning uchun har yakshanba **uning oldiga boramiz**.

sentences.text: Emma's phone is off. I've **texted her** twice.
sentences.translation: Emmaning telefoni o'chiq. **Unga** ikki marta **xabar yozdim**.

sentences.text: James asked for help, so I **helped him** with his essay.
sentences.translation: Jeyms yordam so'radi, shuning uchun inshosida **unga yordam berdim**.

sentences.text: Is that Aziz over there? Let's **wave to him**.
sentences.translation: Anavi Azizmi? Keling, **unga qo'l silkitaylik**.

sentences.text: Our new teacher is very kind, and all the students **like her**.
sentences.translation: Yangi o'qituvchimiz juda mehribon, hamma o'quvchilar **uni yaxshi ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Sarah's brother is a pilot; I **met him** at her wedding.
sentences.translation: Saraning akasi uchuvchi; **u bilan** Saraning to'yida **tanishganman**.

sentences.text: When Grandad gets tired, we **take him** home early.
sentences.translation: Bobom charchab qolsa, **uni** uyga erta **olib ketamiz**.

examples.title: **it** and **them**: don't drop the object
examples.description: Narsa va hayvon haqida — **it**, ko'plikda — **them**. O'zbekchada to'ldiruvchi ko'pincha tushib qoladi («Ha, oldim»), inglizchada olmosh shart: I bought **it**.

sentences.text: This soup is delicious — who **made it**?
sentences.translation: Bu sho'rva juda mazali — **uni** kim **pishirdi**?

sentences.text: I've lost my umbrella and can't **find it** anywhere.
sentences.translation: Soyabonimni yo'qotib qo'ydim, hech qayerdan **topolmayapman**.

sentences.text: These shoes don't fit me, so I'm going to **take them** back to the shop.
sentences.translation: Bu tufli oyog'imga to'g'ri kelmayapti, shuning uchun **uni** do'konga **qaytarib beraman**.

sentences.text: Do you like this song? — Yes, I **love it**!
sentences.translation: Bu qo'shiq sizga yoqadimi? — Ha, **juda yoqadi**!

sentences.text: Here are your keys. Don't **forget them** again!
sentences.translation: Mana kalitlaringiz. **Ularni** yana **unutib qoldirmang**!

sentences.text: The children have a puppy and **feed it** twice a day.
sentences.translation: Bolalarning kuchugi bor, ular **uni** kuniga ikki marta **boqishadi**.

sentences.text: Did you read the letters from the bank? — No, I didn't **open them**.
sentences.translation: Bankdan kelgan xatlarni o'qidingizmi? — Yo'q, **ularni ochmadim**.

sentences.text: My grandfather has an old car, and he **washes it** every Sunday.
sentences.translation: Bobomning eski mashinasi bor, u **uni** har yakshanba **yuvadi**.

sentences.text: I bought some apples at the market and **put them** in the fridge.
sentences.translation: Bozordan olma oldim va **ularni** muzlatgichga **qo'ydim**.

sentences.text: Where's the remote control? — Sorry, I **took it** to my room.
sentences.translation: Pult qayerda? — Kechirasiz, **uni** xonamga **olib ketdim**.

examples.title: After prepositions: **with me**, **for them**
examples.description: Predlogdan keyin faqat to'ldiruvchi shakli: with **me**, for **her**, about **them**. O'zbekchada ko'makchi olmoshdan keyin keladi («men bilan»), inglizchada predlog oldin.

sentences.text: Would you like to have lunch **with us**?
sentences.translation: **Biz bilan** tushlik qilishni xohlaysizmi?

sentences.text: Madina, there's a letter **for you** on the table.
sentences.translation: Madina, stol ustida **sizga** xat bor.

sentences.text: Everyone at school is talking **about him**.
sentences.translation: Maktabda hamma **u haqida** gapiryapti.

sentences.text: I really can't do this job **without them**.
sentences.translation: Bu ishni **ularsiz** umuman qila olmayman.

sentences.text: Come and sit **next to me** — this seat is free.
sentences.translation: Keling, **yonimga** o'tiring — bu joy bo'sh.

sentences.text: We got a lovely card **from her** last week.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta **undan** chiroyli otkritka oldik.

sentences.text: Look! There's a big dog right **behind you**.
sentences.translation: Qarang! Ayni **orqangizda** katta it turibdi.

sentences.text: My parents worry **about me** when I travel alone.
sentences.translation: Yolg'iz sayohat qilganimda ota-onam **men uchun** xavotir olishadi.

sentences.text: Bekzod and Aziz are going to the cinema. Why don't you go **with them**?
sentences.translation: Bekzod bilan Aziz kinoga ketishyapti. Nega **ular bilan** bormaysiz?

sentences.text: The teacher was angry **with us** because we were late again.
sentences.translation: Yana kechikkanimiz uchun o'qituvchining **bizdan** jahli chiqdi.

examples.title: Subject or object? **she** ↔ **her**, **we** ↔ **us**
examples.description: Bitta gapda ikkala shakl: fe'ldan oldin — **she**, **we**, **they**; fe'ldan keyin — **her**, **us**, **them**. Bir odam goh ega, goh to'ldiruvchi bo'ladi va shakli o'zgaradi.

sentences.text: **She** loves **him**, but **he** doesn't love **her**.
sentences.translation: **Qiz** **yigitni** sevadi, lekin **yigit** **qizni** sevmaydi.

sentences.text: **We** called **them**, and then **they** called **us**.
sentences.translation: **Biz** **ularga** qo'ng'iroq qildik, keyin **ular** **bizga** qo'ng'iroq qilishdi.

sentences.text: I like Emma, and I think **she** likes **me** too.
sentences.translation: Menga Emma yoqadi, menimcha, **u** ham **meni** yoqtiradi.

sentences.text: When I speak to **him**, **he** doesn't listen to **me**.
sentences.translation: **Unga** gapirsam, **u** **meni** tinglamaydi.

sentences.text: My grandparents live far away, so **we** don't see **them** often.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim uzoqda yashashadi, shuning uchun **biz** **ularni** tez-tez ko'rmaymiz.

sentences.text: If **they** need help, **they** can ask **us**.
sentences.translation: Agar **ularga** yordam kerak bo'lsa, **bizdan** so'rashlari mumkin.

sentences.text: Why didn't **you** tell **me**? **I** can help **you**.
sentences.translation: Nega **menga** aytmadingiz? **Men** **sizga** yordam bera olaman.

sentences.text: **She** met **him** in Oxford, and a year later **they** got married.
sentences.translation: **U** **yigit** bilan Oksfordda tanishdi, bir yildan keyin **ular** turmush qurishdi.

sentences.text: The children were noisy, so the teacher asked **them** to be quiet.
sentences.translation: Bolalar shovqin qilishdi, shuning uchun o'qituvchi **ulardan** jim turishni so'radi.

sentences.text: **We** saw Tom at the airport, but **he** didn't see **us**.
sentences.translation: **Biz** Tomni aeroportda ko'rdik, lekin **u** **bizni** ko'rmadi.

examples.title: Questions and answers: Do you know **him**?
examples.description: Savol → javob juftliklari. Javobda olmosh aytiladi: Do you know Tom? — Yes, I know **him**. O'zbekchada «Ha, taniyman» yetarli, inglizchada **him** shart.

sentences.text: Do you know Mr Karimov? — Yes, I know **him** very well.
sentences.translation: Janob Karimovni taniysizmi? — Ha, **uni** juda yaxshi taniyman.

sentences.text: Have you seen Sarah today? — No, I haven't seen **her**.
sentences.translation: Bugun Sarani ko'rdingizmi? — Yo'q, **uni** ko'rmadim.

sentences.text: Did you like the film? — Not really, I didn't enjoy **it**.
sentences.translation: Film yoqdimi? — Unchalik emas, **menga yoqmadi**.

sentences.text: Where are the wedding photos? — I put **them** in the blue album.
sentences.translation: To'y suratlari qayerda? — **Ularni** ko'k albomga qo'ydim.

sentences.text: Can you hear **me**? — Yes, I can hear **you** now.
sentences.translation: **Meni** eshityapsizmi? — Ha, endi **sizni** eshityapman.

sentences.text: Who is that woman? — I don't know. I've never seen **her** before.
sentences.translation: Anavi ayol kim? — Bilmayman, **uni** oldin hech ko'rmaganman.

sentences.text: Are your parents coming tonight? — Yes, we're expecting **them** at seven.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz bugun kechqurun kelishadimi? — Ha, **ularni** soat yettida kutyapmiz.

sentences.text: Why are you angry **with him**? — Because he lied **to me**.
sentences.translation: Nega **undan** jahlingiz chiqdi? — Chunki u **menga** yolg'on gapirdi.

sentences.text: Shall we wait for Emma? — No, she's late again. Let's go without **her**.
sentences.translation: Emmani kutamizmi? — Yo'q, u yana kechikyapti. **Usiz** ketaveramiz.

sentences.text: Did the children like the presents? — Yes, they loved **them**!
sentences.translation: Sovg'alar bolalarga yoqdimi? — Ha, **ular** bolalarga juda yoqdi!

examples.title: Dialogue: a surprise for Mum
examples.description: Aka-singil onasiga kutilmagan sovg'a rejalashtiradi. Har bir qatorda to'ldiruvchi shakli: **him**, **her**, **them**, **it**.

sentences.text: — Dilnoza, have you seen Dad? I need to talk **to him**.
sentences.translation: — Dilnoza, dadamni ko'rdingmi? **U bilan** gaplashishim kerak.

sentences.text: — Yes, I saw **him** in the garden a minute ago. What's up?
sentences.translation: — Ha, bir daqiqa oldin **uni** bog'da ko'rdim. Nima gap?

sentences.text: — On Friday Mum turns fifty. Let's surprise **her**!
sentences.translation: — Juma kuni oyim ellik yoshga to'ladi. **Unga** kutilmagan sovg'a qilaylik!

sentences.text: — Great idea! Shall we invite Aunt Lola? Mum loves **her**.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r fikr! Lola xolani taklif qilamizmi? Oyim **uni** juda yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: — Of course. And the neighbours too — we can invite **them** tomorrow.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Qo'shnilarni ham — **ularni** ertaga taklif qilamiz.

sentences.text: — What about a cake? Can you order **it** from the bakery?
sentences.translation: — Tort-chi? **Uni** novvoyxonaga buyurtma qila olasanmi?

sentences.text: — Sure, but don't tell Mum anything. Keep it secret from **her**!
sentences.translation: — Albatta, faqat oyimga hech narsa dema. **Undan** sir saqla!

sentences.text: — Don't worry, I won't say a word **to her**.
sentences.translation: — Xavotir olma, **unga** bir og'iz ham gapirmayman.

sentences.text: — And Dad? Will you explain the plan **to him**?
sentences.translation: — Dadam-chi? Rejani **unga** o'zing tushuntirasanmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, I'll go and find **him** right now.
sentences.translation: — Ha, hozir borib **uni** topaman.

examples.title: Mixed: object pronouns in everyday life
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: fe'ldan keyin, predlogdan keyin va qisqa javobda to'ldiruvchi shakli; o'zbekcha «u» ning to'g'ri tarjimasi.

sentences.text: Every morning Grandad takes **us** to school in his old car.
sentences.translation: Har kuni ertalab bobom **bizni** eski mashinasida maktabga olib boradi.

sentences.text: If you see Madina, please say hello to **her** from me.
sentences.translation: Madinani ko'rsangiz, **unga** mendan salom ayting.

sentences.text: These grapes are from our garden. Try **them**!
sentences.translation: Bu uzum o'zimizning bog'dan. **Tatib ko'ring**!

sentences.text: The new manager is from London, and everybody likes **him**.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer Londondan, **uni** hamma yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: I'm sorry, but I can't go to the concert **with you** tonight.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bugun kechqurun **siz bilan** konsertga bora olmayman.

sentences.text: Who broke the window? — Not **me**! It was Bekzod.
sentences.translation: Derazani kim sindirdi? — **Men emas**! Bekzod sindirdi.

sentences.text: When the guests arrived, my father met **them** at the door.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar kelganda, dadam **ularni** eshik oldida kutib oldi.

sentences.text: Sarah is coming by train, so we're picking **her** up at the station.
sentences.translation: Sara poyezdda kelyapti, shuning uchun **uni** vokzaldan olib ketamiz.

sentences.text: That's a beautiful photo! Can I keep **it**?
sentences.translation: Qanday chiroyli surat! **Uni** olib qolsam maylimi?

sentences.text: Our neighbours are very kind: last winter they helped **us** a lot when we were ill.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz juda mehribon: o'tgan qish kasal bo'lganimizda **bizga** ko'p yordam berishdi.
